dedupe.note: Nonblocking stern admission, overloaded VERIFIED semantics and immutable per-invocation effect correlation are already represented by earlier branch/main deltas. These packets strengthen provenance but are not double-counted as independent evidence.

semantic_atoms.claim: evaluate_head resolves dependencies from a central DAG, returns NOT_COMPUTED/value=None for unknown or COMPUTE_OFF heads and for taint-blocked dependencies, and does so before compute_fn executes. Caller-supplied dependency lists cannot override the DAG.
semantic_atoms.authority: local perception compute/egress policy enforcement only
known_counterevidence: System-wide privacy credit remains unproven until source-wide reachability shows all live perception callers pass through evaluate_head rather than raw compute functions.
semantic_atoms.world_substrate_delta: WorldNeed/WorldSlice must carry typed KNOWN/UNKNOWN/CONFLICT/NOT_COMPUTED states. Protected COMPUTE_OFF variables and any derived dependency chain remain NOT_COMPUTED; downstream vector similarity, decomposition or model inference may not reconstruct them as a policy bypass.
semantic_atoms.acceptance_falsifier: Disable one protected world variable, request a downstream derived variable whose operator depends on it, and prove the derived variable remains NOT_COMPUTED and the protected compute/operator is never invoked.

semantic_atoms.claim: Realtime function calls are held in a session-local pending queue and dispatched only after response.done with status completed. Non-completed responses clear the queue; barge-in also clears pending calls before truncate/cancel, preventing an interrupted thought from dispatching its still-pending tool call.
semantic_atoms.authority: pending pre-dispatch voice-effect cancellation only; not canonical EffectGate and not proof about already-submitted external effects
semantic_atoms.grid10_delta: Generalize this as typed candidate/effect lifecycle: CANDIDATE -> PENDING_DISPATCH -> CANCELLED_BEFORE_DISPATCH when the parent cognitive turn is cancelled/superseded. Once an external effect may have been submitted, cancellation cannot mint NOT_EXECUTED; outcome becomes UNKNOWN until verified.
semantic_atoms.acceptance_falsifier: Emit a pending tool candidate, cancel/supersede its parent turn before dispatch, and prove zero executor submission receipts for that invocation; separately simulate transport ambiguity after submission and prove state remains UNKNOWN rather than CANCELLED or blindly replayed.

semantic_atoms.claim: VoiceSessionCapsule is rebuilt from multiple fresh sources and is intentionally an ephemeral projection, but the inspected builder does not provide one shared generation/transaction identity across presence, visual state, memory refs, permissions, privacy policy and winning intent. Missing presence is converted to user_present=True for arbitration.
known_counterevidence: Fresh per-refresh reads reduce long-lived staleness but do not by themselves prove cross-source consistency.
semantic_atoms.grid10_delta: The Voice/GRID context compiler must use a bounded consistent-read contract or explicit generation/freshness stamps across selected fields. Presence unavailable stays UNKNOWN/None and can drive WAIT/ASK/re-observe; it must not default to present=True.
semantic_atoms.acceptance_falsifier: Force one capsule source to stale generation and another to current generation; prove the compiler marks/rejects the mixed projection rather than silently producing a high-confidence speech decision.

architecture_deltas.delta: Port Perception Control's central DAG taint plus NOT_COMPUTED semantics into sparse WorldNeed/WorldSlice materialization and Cognitive-Twin controls.

Add explicit pre-dispatch cancellation state bound to immutable invocation identity; cancellation of a parent cognitive turn invalidates only not-yet-submitted candidates. Submitted-but-unverified external effects remain UNKNOWN until verified.
Compile voice context from provenance-bearing, generation/freshness-checked GRID slices; preserve UNKNOWN presence and disallow default-present fallback in Frankenstein 2.0.

contradictions.resolution: The donor VoiceSessionCapsule builder explicitly falls back to user_present=True when presence is unavailable. Frankenstein 2.0 must preserve UNKNOWN instead; source confirmation does not close the migration repair.

The new packets reinforce the existing conclusion that stern admission bookkeeping is nonblocking and VERIFIED overloads admission/outcome semantics. Do not grant new independent evidence credit; use the already-persisted effect contract as Triggerword-4 authority input.

next_exact_gate: Audit source-wide evaluate_head reachability and encode three Triggerword-4 regressions: protected WorldSlice dependency remains NOT_COMPUTED, cancelled parent turn yields zero pre-dispatch effect submissions, and mixed-generation/unknown-presence Voice context cannot become a high-confidence proactive SPEAK decision.
